name: Adelaide Hills

climate: Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay and Shiraz sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

notes: Adelaide Hills Chardonnay is medium weight with good natural acidity, and some from cooler sites goes into sparkling wine.
Sauvignon Blanc is the region's most widely planted white grape.

blurb.text: A region in the hills east of Adelaide in South Australia, part of the Mount Lofty Ranges zone, with Lenswood and Piccadilly Valley inside it. Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay each make up 23 percent of plantings, followed by Pinot Noir at 18 percent.
